{{Top|leg}}
A '''family unit''' was the basic unit of the society of the [[Xi'Dec/Legends|Xi'Dec]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Each family unit contained of two or more Xi'Dec and no more than a single member of each of the species' [[Gender/Legends|sexes]], which numbered more than 180.<ref name="GG42">[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'', Second Edition]]</ref>
